description: This file defines a struct BufferSliceReaderInput that serves as an input reader for buffer slices, supporting iteration and data retrieval functions in a serialization context within Orleans framework.

classes.name: BufferSliceReaderInput
classes.description: A struct supporting reading operations over a BufferSlice, used in serialization processes.

methods.name: BufferSliceReaderInput
methods.description: Constructor initializing the reader with a buffer slice.

methods.name: ForkFrom
methods.description: Creates a new BufferSliceReaderInput starting from a specified position within the buffer slice.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next span of bytes from the buffer for reading.
